sloka: इत्युक्त्वा बाणमाकर्णं विकृष्य तमजिह्मगम्।लक्ष्मणः समरे वीरः ससर्जेन्द्रजितं प्रति।ऐन्द्रास्त्रेण समायोज्य लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा ।। ६.९१.७३ ।।
transliteration: ityuktvā bāṇamākarṇaṁ vikṛṣya tamajihmagam।lakṣmaṇaḥ samare vīraḥ sasarjendrajitaṁ prati।aindrāstreṇa samāyojya lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā ।। 6.91.73 ।।

translations.english: Prosperous Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemies, aiming at Indrajith's head shining with earrings belonging to the head severed from the body, it fell on ground.
